translation: An orientation toward ends, purposes, or fulfillment rather than a view of things as only pushed around by blind causes.

vervaeke_usage: Vervaeke uses teleology to recover why living systems, practices, and persons often make more sense when understood in terms of realization, orientation, and purpose rather than mere mechanism.
